attempts.description: Some broad preliminary artifact displays and a recursive packaging search exceeded tool output limits. Targeted root/descriptor/manifest reads and complete byte-level checks supplied the review inputs. No source or archive was modified.

An exploratory listing used the repository cwd for a workspace audit path and reported that the directory did not exist. The review directory was subsequently created only at its assigned workspace path.

attempts.reason: The first runner required one recovery-map row per original path. The map intentionally embeds audit/FINAL-FREEZE-INPUT.json at two package paths with identical size, hash and mode. Unique ZIP entry names and manifest inventory had already passed. This was an overly strict reviewer assertion, not a defective archive.
attempts.correction: Validate unique origin/destination pairs and identical content/mode for every repeated original; then verify each original and packaged copy.
